title: SD3 NEU Final SR-L
wikitext:
[[Image:SD EU.gif|right|SD EU Logo]] == Introduction == * Competition: [[SD NEU Season 3|Smackdown North Europe 3]] * Round: Final * Match: [[Slackers]] vs [[Lithium]] * Date: 9-12-2001 == Screenshots == === E1M2 === [[Image:SD3_NEU_Final_SR-L_e1m2.jpg]]
It felt quite safe, we had good control of gl/quad. Vana picked up alot of quads and owned :). But they played good and gave us a tough fight.
[http://www.challenge-tv.com/index.php?mode=demodetail&demo=13345 Demo] from [[Vana]]'s point of view
[http://www.challenge-tv.com/index.php?mode=demodetail&demo=13349 Demo] from [[Xalibur]]s point of view === DM3 === [[Image:SD3_NEU_Final_SR-L_dm3.jpg]]
I got first RL, and owned everything until first pent. At that moment we had 3 RL guys, all of us died, they got pent and all of a sudden we were owned by 3 enemy RL's.
[http://www.challenge-tv.com/index.php?mode=demodetail&demo=13345 Demo] from [[Vana]]'s point of view
[http://www.challenge-tv.com/index.php?mode=demodetail&demo=13349 Demo] from [[Xalibur]]s point of view === DM2 === [[Image:SD3_NEU_Final_SR-L_dm2.jpg]]
First they got quite good control, and held that for like 7 mins Then something came over us and we did NNIJA comeback and retook the map. ParadokS played brilliant, as I asume the rest of us did as well, and we won. Deffently our best round this match.
[http://www.challenge-tv.com/index.php?mode=demodetail&demo=13345 Demo] from [[Vana]]'s point of view
[http://www.challenge-tv.com/index.php?mode=demodetail&demo=13349 Demo] from [[Xalibur]]s point of view === DM2 === [[Image:SD3_NEU_Final_SR-L_dm2-2.jpg]]
Since we ere leading 2 to 1 in maps, it was L's turn to pick. Having last round still in mind it seemed odd that they wanted to play the very same level over again. But i guess it came as a suprice we could actually play that level so well, and it must have been all luck :) This time Goljat was the one leading our team, me and para quadrunned and vana kept lower stable. I think watching these games live, or after is well worth the time. L was a great opponent and very suited for the finals of QW's most prestiguefilled leauge today. GG -Report by [[Xalibur]]/[[ParadokS]]
